# Tessera

> A small copy-paste React UI kit built on Tailwind CSS v4 and CSS variables. Warm editorial design, custom tile theme glyphs, no runtime dependency.

Canonical URL: https://dhirajaryaa.github.io/tessera
Source: https://github.com/dhirajaryaa/tessera
Components: 14
Themes: paper, ink, moss, plus a system preference

## Install

Initialize once:

    npx github:dhirajaryaa/tessera#main init

Add parts:

    npx github:dhirajaryaa/tessera#main add button dialog
    npx github:dhirajaryaa/tessera#main add theme-switcher

List the registry:

    npx github:dhirajaryaa/tessera#main list

Init writes `tessera.json`, copies `tessera.css` and `utils.ts`, and adds the CSS import after Tailwind:

    @import "tailwindcss";
    @import "./tessera.css";

The root element needs a theme:

    <html lang="en" data-theme="paper">

## Components

- button: solid, soft, outline, ghost, link. Sizes sm, md, lg, icon. Supports loading.
- badge: neutral, accent, outline, success, warning, danger. Optional dot.
- input: Input plus Field and Label for labels, hints and errors.
- textarea: multi-line text with a vertical resize handle.
- select: native select with a custom chevron. Takes option children.
- checkbox: native checkbox with a label and optional description.
- switch: immediate on or off. Uses a native checkbox with role switch.
- card: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter.
- tabs: Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent with arrow-key navigation.
- dialog: Dialog and DialogClose. Trigger prop, focus trap, Escape, focus restore.
- toast: ToastProvider and useToast. Polite live region, auto-dismiss.
- accordion: Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent. Single or multiple.
- avatar: Avatar and AvatarGroup. Image or initials fallback.
- theme-switcher: ThemeProvider, useTheme, ThemeSwitcher, ThemeGlyph.

## API shapes

    <Button variant="solid" size="md" loading={false}>Save</Button>
    <Badge tone="success" dot>Active</Badge>

    <Field label="Email" htmlFor="email" hint="Receipts only.">
      <Input id="email" type="email" />
    </Field>

    <Field label="Plan" htmlFor="plan">
      <Select id="plan"><option value="studio">Studio</option></Select>
    </Field>

    <Checkbox label="Email me a receipt" defaultChecked />
    <Switch label="Weekly digest" checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn} />

    <Tabs defaultValue="general">
      <TabsList aria-label="Sections">
        <TabsTrigger value="general">General</TabsTrigger>
      </TabsList>
      <TabsContent value="general">...</TabsContent>
    </Tabs>

    <Dialog
      title="Invite a teammate"
      trigger={<Button>Invite</Button>}
      footer={<DialogClose>Cancel</DialogClose>}
    >
      ...
    </Dialog>

    <Accordion type="single" collapsible defaultValue="one">
      <AccordionItem value="one">
        <AccordionTrigger>Question</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionContent>Answer</AccordionContent>
      </AccordionItem>
    </Accordion>

Common mistakes:

- Button has no `primary` variant. The default is `solid`.
- Badge uses `tone`, not `variant`.
- Input has no label prop. Use Field.
- Select takes option children, not an options array.
- Dialog uses a `trigger` prop, not DialogTrigger or DialogContent.

## Tokens

Every component uses these variables and no palette classes:

--ts-bg, --ts-surface, --ts-surface-2, --ts-ink, --ts-muted, --ts-line, --ts-line-strong, --ts-accent, --ts-accent-hover, --ts-accent-ink, --ts-success, --ts-warning, --ts-danger, --ts-radius, --ts-font-sans, --ts-font-mono, --ts-font-display, --ts-shadow.

Default radius: 8px.
Accent: one per screen. Primary actions, active indicators and focus rings.

## Rules

- Use native HTML and React state. No Radix, Headless UI, React Aria or CVA.
- Do not add a runtime UI package.
- Do not hard-code colours, radii or fonts outside the tokens.
- Do not replace the four tile theme glyphs with sun and moon icons.
- Keep keyboard access, visible focus, ARIA state, Escape and focus restore.
- Copy is plain and specific. No marketing filler.
